source_delta.required_change: Change the mapping condition to type(value) is dict or isinstance(value, Mapping), preserving the existing common strict-key recursive-copy loop exactly. Exact built-in dict skips redundant ABC classification; all non-exact-dict values retain original isinstance(Mapping) dispatch and fallback. Prefer this one-line change; no scalar refactor required.
source_delta.list_boundary: The exact-list branch stays after Mapping, unchanged. Moving it earlier can change precedence if list is virtually registered as a Mapping or a Mapping implementation is substituted. No list reordering/fast-path before Mapping is authorized. Existing list branch still creates a fresh list and recursively validates each element.
source_delta.mapping_boundary: dict subclasses, Mapping implementations and virtual subclasses always use the original isinstance/each items() call/iteration order/duplicate-key detection. Do not replace items() with dict(value), skip custom iteration, trust schema/type hints, or broaden accepted subclasses. Unsupported list/scalar subclasses remain rejected as before unless the existing Mapping route accepts them.
source_delta.strictness: All strict str-key checks, duplicate checks, exact integer bounds -(2**63) < value < 2**63, bool/int distinction, float finiteness, unsupported live-object rejection, exception propagation and recursive traversal order remain.
